version: v1.5.0 — FPS Boost + Turbo F2/F10 + Browsing (Game 1.0.9)
name: Geoplanetical Fire Performance Mod
description:
Made this mod for my laptop (8GB RAM / integrated graphics) to get smooth 60 FPS and make Speed 3 actually fast, but works great on all PCs!

WHAT IT DOES:
- Massive FPS Boost (removes heavy 8K textures, 3D clouds/atmosphere, and UI compositor blurs)
- Turbo Speed 3 (>>> runs way faster at ~16 days/sec with smooth daily date counter)
- Month-End UI Browsing (browse budget/trade/diplomacy tabs while month calculates without freezing)
- Hotkeys: Press F10 for Fire Graphics, press F2 for Turbo Speed 3 (F11 fullscreen is untouched!)

EASY 1-CLICK INSTALL:
Because Steam Workshop only loads flags/images by default, run the installer once:
1. In Geoplanetical main menu, click "Mods".
2. Click "Mod studio" on this mod, then click "Open folder".
3. Double-click Install-Mod.bat and wait until it says Done.
4. Launch the game! You will see 'FIRE [F10] · TURBO [F2]' and FPS in the top-right corner.

HOW TO TOGGLE OR UNINSTALL:
- Press F10 anytime to toggle Fire Graphics ON/OFF with an on-screen toast.
- Press F2 anytime to toggle Turbo Speed 3 ON/OFF.
- Or turn mod off in Mods menu, or run Uninstall-Mod.bat to restore original game files.

OUR JOURNEY & CHANGELOG:
[v1.5.0]
- Split hotkeys: F10 Graphics, F2 Turbo (avoided F11 conflict with vanilla fullscreen)
- Added 2-second floating on-screen toast notifications on hotkey press
- Added Month-End UI Browsing during heavy simulation ticks
- Simplified 1-click install via Mod Studio 'Open folder'

[v1.4.0]
- Game v1.0.9 update compatibility (unpacked simulation worker)
- Fixed "node not recognized" (runs via game's own Node engine, zero-Node needed!)
- Patched Mod Studio validation to permit empty provides without unwanted Flags tag
- Custom 64-char presentation version labels

[v1.3.1]
- Added live in-game F10 toggle
- Fixed daily date progression ticker during Turbo Speed 3

[v1.0.0]
- Initial release: Sub-second ASAR patcher, flat globe shader, 2K canvas, CSS blur removal, 16x Speed 3
